privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: Stiamond ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal data when you use our website and services.
privacy.s2Body: We collect the following types of data:
privacy.s2Contact: Contact data: name, email, company, phone number when you submit forms.
privacy.s2Account: Account data: email, password (hashed), profile information.
privacy.s2Usage: Usage data: pages visited, browser type, IP address, timestamps.
privacy.s2Project: Project data: information you share about your projects and requirements.
s3Items: To provide and maintain our services
To respond to your inquiries and provide support
To send project updates and relevant communications
To improve our website and services
privacy.s4Body: Your data is stored in encrypted PostgreSQL databases hosted on Neon, with edge delivery via Cloudflare. We use industry-standard encryption (TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest) and follow OWASP security practices. Access is restricted via RBAC and audit logging.
privacy.s5Body: Under GDPR and similar regulations, you have the right to:
privacy.s6Body: For privacy inquiries, contact us at

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: By accessing or using Stiamond's website and services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.
terms.s2Body: Stiamond provides AI engineering, software engineering, cloud infrastructure, and growth systems services. Specific deliverables, timelines, and pricing are defined in individual project agreements.
terms.s3Body: All custom work delivered to clients is transferred upon full payment, unless otherwise specified in the project agreement. Stiamond retains ownership of its proprietary tools, frameworks, and platform components.
terms.s4Body: Payment terms are defined per project agreement. Invoices are due within 30 days of issuance. Late payments may incur interest charges as permitted by law.
terms.s5Body: Both parties agree to keep confidential all proprietary information shared during the course of engagement. This obligation survives termination of the agreement.
terms.s6Body: Stiamond's liability is limited to the fees paid for the specific project giving rise to the claim. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.
